newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Seven buys US$100 mln of MGM stock.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Seven buys US$100 mln of MGM stock.

text.p: Television operator Seven Network Ltd said on Tuesday that it had taken up its option to acquire US$100 million of preferred stock in Hollywood film studio Metro Goldwyn Mayer (MGM) from Kirk Kerkorian's unlisted Tracinda Corp.
Seven, which operates the second-ranked television network in Australia, said the MGM option formed part of the US$1.3 billion takeover of the film studio in partnership with Tracinda Corp last July.
Seven said it originally committed US$250 million to the takeover and in return gained 50 percent of the MGM voting rights and equal board representation with Tracinda.
"Our decision to take up our option in Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer underlines our commitment to the future strengthening of the company," Seven chairman Kerry Stokes said.
"The decision also reflects the underlying strength of our partnership with Kirk Kerkorian's Tracinda Corp," he said.
Seven shares were 9.6 cents lower at A$5.66 at 4.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Tuesday.
